title: target project uses venv/, not system python
context: stockshark has venv/bin/python with pytest and ruff, system python lacks them
takeaway: always detect venv/ first, use venv/bin/python -m pytest/ruff instead of bare commands

title: verifier wastes turns on redundant file reads
context: GLM verifier re-reads files it already has in context, averaging 10+ tool calls
takeaway: keep verifier prompt strict: list steps explicitly, cap at 10 turns, forbid re-reading known files

title: verify_mechanical should only check changed files
context: full project lint fails on pre-existing issues unrelated to the change
takeaway: use git diff --name-only since pre_sha to get changed .py files, only lint those
